description: exp016 - dim-64 single-stream LUT-GPT with a HyperplaneMultiHeadLUT UNEMBEDDER mapping the 64-dim hidden DIRECTLY to 32768 logits (stay in ranking space to the logits). Derived from exp014 (dim256) but: dim E=D=64, 4 heads x head_dim 16, untied embeddings, 6 layers, ctx 512, vocab 32768, RoPE 1e4. Standard Euclidean softmax attention (allowed exception) with qk/v/out_proj = HyperplaneMultiHeadLUT (anchor_pairs, hard); out_proj doubles as unify-heads + FFN (no MLP). REMOVED: residual_lut, emb_resid_lut, dual-stream. per-site naps qk4/v6/out6, shared tph 64; unembedder nap6/tph4/n_heads1 (table ~8.39M). Recipe = exp014 (16k steps, Lion 2e-4 tables / AdamW 3e-4 no-wd hyperplanes by name, grad clip 1.0, warmup 0.1 cosine, bf16 tables + fp32 master). BUILD-FOR-REVIEW: not launched.
